question: A takes 42 hours to complete a work. B completes the same work in two-third of the time taken by A. What fraction of the work will they do in 14 hours?
solution:
Given:

A takes 42 hours to complete a work. 

B completes the same work in two-thirds of the time taken by A.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken 

Calculation:

Time taken by B to complete the work
